launches.title: Resin Technologies: AI-enabled electronics firm
launches.tagline: Send us a spec and get back reliable, working boards in a fraction of the usual time
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Anmol and Koosha, the founders of [Resin Technologies](https://resintechnologies.com/).

**Resin designs the electronics inside hardware products.** Send us a spec, a sketch, or a board you already have. We design it, get it manufactured, and validate it, then hand you working hardware. We build our own AI design software, so we turn boards around much faster than a traditional design shop, and we catch mistakes before fabrication.

<https://youtu.be/HaeItkU4Bv8>

**The problem**

Every hardware product needs custom electronics. But building electronics is hard:

* **Hard to staff:** Electronics involves highly intricate engineering work and hiring skilled electronics engineers can take a long time.
* **Mistakes are costly** one missed wiring or rating error means a respin and weeks of lost schedule.
* **Outsourcing isn’t reliable and not fully hands off:** consultancies take weeks per revision, and often don’t handle manufacturing.

**How we work**

1. **Tell us about your board.** A sketch, a schematic, or a description of the problem is enough to start. From simple prototypes to complex multilayer, high-density, and RF designs, we work across applications ranging from robotics to wearables.
2. **We design it.** We pair our world class engineers with in-house AI tooling to pick parts, draft the schematic design, review it for errors, and lay out the board.
3. **We build and validate it.** We handle fabrication and assembly, then bring the board up and test it before it reaches you.

We also improve existing boards: respins, cost-downs, and replacing obsolete parts.

**Traction**

**We reached six figures in annualized revenue two weeks after our launch.** For one customer, we shipped a high-density multilayer board in days. The same work had previously taken them months, and the speed helped them meet a critical deadline.

Our customers build everything from consumer wearables to industrial robots for Apple!

**Team**

**Koosha (CTO)** has spent his career designing production electronics. He worked on driver-assistance systems at Bosch, worked on haptics at IHS, and was a Senior Robotics Engineer at A&K Robotics. He's also an IPhO gold medalist.

\
**Anmol (CEO)** has spent more than a decade working on applied AI. He led the FDE team at [You.com](http://You.com), was the first engineer at LassieAI, built ML systems at Borealis AI, and worked on robotics research at UBC. 

We met in undergrad purusing Engineering Physics @ UBC. We've been close friends for more than 10 years!

**Our asks**

**Building a hardware product and need a board designed, or an existing one fixed?** Email [**hello@resintechnologies.com**](mailto:hello@resintechnologies.com)

**Know a hardware team that could use help with electronics?** We'd love an intro - please email [hello@resintechnologies.com](mailto:hello@resintechnologies.com)

launches.title: Resin - Codex for electronics
launches.tagline: AI-native ECAD that allows engineers to design PCB chips faster and more reliably
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Koosha and Anmol, the founders of Resin. We’re building an AI-native PCB design tool that helps engineers turn ideas into working electronics faster and more reliably.

**Demo: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JByTuaHHHGg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JByTuaHHHGg)**

Mandatory GIF:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=120163&key=user_uploads/501763/ddae1ba4-75e5-43a7-9a30-fe4fa392848f)

**Problem we’re solving**

* **PCB design is slow and manual:** Engineers can spend weeks reading datasheets, finding components, drawing schematics, and routing connections on traditional design tools. 
* **Design mistakes are expensive:** A design error that only gets surfaced _after_ fabrication can require redesigning and manufacturing the board again, adding weeks/months of delay and cost.
* **Requires expertise:** Good board design takes years of experience to master, so many smaller companies can't do it in-house. Resin makes it accessible to experts and non-experts (including hobbyists) alike.

**How Resin solves this problem**

Resin brings AI into a complete ECAD workspace to increase engineering velocity & design reliability:

* **Draft and review schematics:** Describe your requirements. Resin researches parts, drafts schematics, and documents its design decisions. It also reviews existing designs to help catch mistakes before manufacturing.
* **Find or generate any part:** Tell Resin which component you need. It searches millions of parts, analyzes them deeply and generates accurate symbols and footprints.
* **Route boards:** Connect selected signals or your whole board with our proprietary routing engine. We’re especially excited about this one!
* **In the cloud and collaborative:** Resin runs fully in the cloud, and allows seamless collaboration across multiple users!
* **Prepare for manufacturing:** Check component pricing and availability, manage your bill of materials, and export manufacturing files.
* **Stay in control:** Resin is a complete EDA workspace with full schematic, PCB tooling (**and not a mere chatbot!**). Users can delegate entire workflows to AI or get hands-on with individual components, connections, and traces. Every AI change is editable and auditable.
* **Bring existing work into Resin:** We have full support for project & library imports from Altium & KiCad so you can continue existing projects in Resin! There are more integrations on the way!
* **MCP compatible:** Work from Claude Code, Codex, etc.

**Team**

We’ve been long time friends — we met in college where we studied Engineering Physics together! Koosha has tons of electronics and hardware experience, having designed very complex hardware at Bosch, Kodak, IHS. Anmol mostly recently led the FDE team at [you.com](http://you.com) and was an early member at various successful AI startups.

**Our Asks**

**Are you or your team building hardware with PCBs? Sign up with this link to get started with some bonus credits [https://resineda.com/signup?promo=YC2026](https://resineda.com/signup?promo=YC2026)!** We’ll reach out for an onboarding!

**Know someone who designs electronics? We’d love intros** to other founders, electrical engineers, hardware leads whether they’re building robots, drones, medical devices, industrial equipment, or consumer products. 

**Contact**: Email [anmol@resineda.com](mailto:anmol@resineda.com), text 415 425 4809, or DM me on bookface!
